enrichment.headline: Accepts up to $1.18M from the state toxic substances agency to revitalize the Center site

money.evidence: $1,182,300.00 in Equitable Community Revitalization Grant reimbursement funding

enrichment.summary: The district accepts a state grant of up to $1,182,300.00 from the California Department of Toxic Substances Control to revitalize the Center site at 2850 West Street. The grant reimburses the district for costs, so the district is paid back after it spends. The grant runs from October 1, 2024 through September 30, 2026.

attachments.name: 24-3044 Subgrant Agreement - The Children's Partnership - #SG2024025 - Department of Health Care Services - Oakland Technical High School

enrichment.headline: Accepts $945,805 from The Children's Partnership for a student mental health pilot at Oakland Tech
enrichment.summary: The district, on behalf of Oakland Technical High School, accepts a $945,805.00 subgrant from The Children's Partnership, working with the California Department of Health Care Services. The money pays for a pilot project in which high school students support each other's mental health. The grant runs from August 9, 2024 through June 30, 2027.

items.fundingSource: The Children’s Partnership Grant via the Department of Health Care Services
